scripts.title: Infinite Damage
scripts.script:
if getgenv().hook then
    print("ignoring rehook")
else
    getgenv().hook = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        if tostring(self) == "GetBaseAttackDamage" and method == "InvokeServer" then
            print("hooked damage")
            return 100000000000
        end
        return hook(self, ...)
    end)
end
